title: Exception Handling in PL/pgSQL
description: Handle runtime database errors, catch specific SQLSTATE codes, and raise custom exceptions.

data.text: In PL/pgSQL functions and stored procedures, exceptions can be caught and handled using `BEGIN ... EXCEPTION WHEN ... THEN` blocks.

data.title: Catching Unique Constraint Violations in PL/pgSQL
Key Takeaways
points: Use `EXCEPTION WHEN condition` to catch runtime errors.
`SQLSTATE` and `SQLERRM` provide error codes and descriptive text.
Exception blocks create internal subtransactions with minor performance overhead.
